title: Spex Machina Task Journal Line
description: Schema for one line of spec/.history.jsonl, the task journal linking spec nodes to tasks. Each line is a self-contained object: a change event, a task receipt, or a refresh receipt. There is no envelope, no counter, and no integer id anywhere in the format.

changeEvent.description: Records what a baselining absorbed for one spec node.

eid.description: The event's own id, deriving from (git_head, op_id).

node.description: The changed node's identity hash — the same key the merkle tree files that node's leaf under.

node_type.description: The task-owning kinds (component, data_flow, test_section) plus the refresh-absorbable kinds (requirement, api). A kind that never owns a task of its own has no entry.

before.description: The content leaf's hash before the change, or null — an add has no before.

after.description: The content leaf's hash after the change, or null — a removal has no after.

proposal.description: The proposal slug that produced this event.

path.description: The node's content-leaf path. Present when the node has one; absent for requirement and api events.

taskReceipt.description: Records what the tracker did in response to a change event or a proposal epic.

for.description: The eid of the change event this receipt answers.

proposal.description: The proposal slug this epic receipt answers.

refreshReceipt.description: Records a refresh run absorbing no-bead-work drift.

git_head.description: The git head the refresh ran at, admitting recorded absence.

absorbed.description: The eids of the change events this refresh absorbed. Empty when the refresh absorbed nothing, though a no-drift run appends nothing at all.
